scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Indexed binary words of length 2n with two length-n halves of identical scattered-subsequence counts through length 2; n tends to infinity.
scientific_integrity.limitations: No explicit rate of convergence, no higher-alphabet result, and no independent audit; previous implicit or unindexed statements may affect historical priority.
scientific_integrity.proof_dependency: Uniform local limit theorem for Mahonian inversions of multiset permutations (Canfield–Janson–Zeilberger 2009, Theorem 4.5).

title: Sharp asymptotic density of binary \(2\)-binomial squares
